verdict.rationale: Lithic ships an official MCP server that lets an AI agent search docs, generate code, and execute live API calls, and a dedicated blog post walks through an agent creating a virtual card, assigning it to an account, and configuring authorization rules/spend limits and running test transactions — directly matching the 'create/update cards and adjust spend controls' part of the story. API key-gated access is documented, but there is no explicit evidence of reading balances/transactions via the agent surface or of fine-grained scoped/permissioned credentials distinct from a standard API key. Missing for 10: explicit balance/transaction read capability through MCP/API, and documentation of scoped (least-privilege) credentials for agent use.
